apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Vibrations you can follow by feel: push swells, hold is a thud plus a heartbeat with 3 ticks before release, lowering fades, rests get countdown ticks, last rep is a triple tap, cuff warnings at 8 and 10 min. Try them all in Settings.
Ring combines A and D: notches for reps (now up to 40) and sets; during BFR the outer ring becomes the 10-minute cuff dial with set dots in the middle.

Session ring now has notches: outer ring = sets, inner ring = reps. Big number is the rep you're on for quick reps, seconds for holds and rests. Cuff time moved into the badge and turns red at 8 minutes.
